jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

needs_verification.title: Operations Analyst
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: You will manage the operational processes supporting market data distribution, ensuring accurate licensing administration, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with external providers and internal stakeholders. Manage new data licensing agreements and renewals with exchange groups and other market data providers. Track licensing terms, renewal dates, contractual obligations, and deadlines to ensure continuous compliance. Prepare and submit accurate monthly usage reports for each data feed to the relevant data providers within established deadlines. Monitor licensing arrangements for brokers and partners redistributing market data, maintaining up-to-date evidence of their distribution licenses and authorizations. Enable and disable data feeds for broker and partner customers in accordance with their licensing agreements and contractual requirements. Respond to data provider audits and inquiries, ensuring that licensing records and supporting documentation remain complete and accurate. Identify opportunities to improve and automate licensing, reporting, and entitlement management processes. Assist with customer support inquiries related to market data feeds, licensing, and access permissions. Collaborate with internal teams across market data, sales, legal, finance, and engineering to ensure smooth operational coordination. Requirements The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple operational responsibilities and recurring deadlines in a financial services environment. At least 2 years of experience in operations, ideally in market data administration, data licensing, or vendor management within financial services. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Strong organizational and time-management abilities, particularly when managing multiple counterparties, contractual obligations, and recurring deadlines. Ability to read, interpret, and apply contractual terms and data licensing requirements. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Familiarity with exchange market data policies and usage reporting requirements, including NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe, OPRA, and CTA/UTP, is an advantage. Experience with market data inventory and usage reporting tools is a plus. SQL or scripting knowledge for reporting automation is beneficial. Understanding of financial markets and related industry practices is an advantage. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and adapt to a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working remotely within a globally distributed team. Benefits Competitive salary. Stock options. Health benefits. One-time USD 500 allowance for setting up your home office when joining. Monthly USD 150 stipend provided through a Brex Card. Opportunity to work with an international and geographically distributed team. Exposure to innovative financial technology and global market data infrastructure. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? needs_verification.title: Resource Management Analyst
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Manage resource requests and staffing system administration, ensuring that staffing plans, resource assignments, and availability information remain accurate and up to date. Maintain employee skills, certifications, and resource profiles within Certinia to support effective workforce planning and informed staffing decisions. Create, update, and maintain dashboards, trackers, and recurring reports covering utilization, resource capacity, open demand, staffing allocations, and other key resource management metrics. Support weekly and monthly reporting activities, ensuring the timely preparation and delivery of accurate resource management updates and operational insights. Analyze resource management data to identify trends, staffing variances, capacity constraints, and potential workforce planning challenges. Collaborate with practice teams and internal stakeholders to resolve data discrepancies, follow up on outstanding resource requests, and maintain reliable operational information. Monitor resource allocation and availability data to help ensure efficient staffing decisions and alignment with project requirements. Identify opportunities to streamline administrative activities, improve data quality, and enhance reporting processes through continuous improvement and automation. Support the development and optimization of resource management workflows, tools, and reporting practices. Leverage emerging technologies and AI-powered solutions to improve operational productivity, simplify repetitive tasks, and support scalable business processes. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Analytics, or a related discipline. At least 1 year of experience in business operations, resource management, data analysis, or a related field. Relevant internship experience is also considered. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI, including data management, formulas, reporting, and dashboard development. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize, validate, interpret, and present data accurately. An interest in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, with a proactive approach to exploring how these tools can improve workflows, increase productivity, and support operational scalability. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and follow up professionally on outstanding requests. Excellent organizational and time management abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities, maintain accuracy, and meet deadlines. High attention to detail and a structured approach to maintaining records, tracking information, and preparing reports. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving processes, priorities, and business requirements. Nice-to-have qualifications: Previous internship or professional experience in consulting, professional services, or business operations. Familiarity with Salesforce, FinancialForce (Certinia), Power BI, or similar enterprise business systems. Experience maintaining dashboards, preparing operational reports, or analyzing large datasets. Exposure to resource management, workforce planning, staffing coordination, or utilization tracking. Interest in process improvement, workflow automation, and the practical application of AI tools in business operations. Benefits: Annual compensation: INR 9–14 LPA, depending on professional experience, expertise, certifications, educational background, and alignment with industry standards. Competitive employee benefits provided through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement with DEEL. Statutory benefits and employment-related administrative support managed through the EOR. Coordinate security-related incidents with the dedicated Defender and Security teams through established procedures. Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems and endpoint troubleshooting. Familiarity with Windows updates, software installation, device connectivity, and system settings. Understanding of incident management, SLA compliance, ticket prioritization, and escalation procedures. Good communication, documentation, and shift handover skills. Ability to follow technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, and established security policies. Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and reporting technical issues. Willingness to work rotational shifts in a 24/7 production support environment. Basic understanding of application deployment and patch management. Microsoft MD-102 fundamentals or equivalent endpoint management training. Exposure to enterprise monitoring and endpoint management tools. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within India. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. Good to Have Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools. Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical solution designs aligned with ServiceNow best practices. Evaluate the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, prioritizing out-of-the-box (OOTB) solutions over unnecessary customizations. Configure, enhance, and support ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), including case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, and knowledge management. Develop and maintain Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) capabilities, including product and quote catalogs, order capture, fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and manufacturing workflows. Design and develop custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Workspaces, and Service Portal. Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony platforms, on-premise applications, and databases using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets. Implement, configure, and optimize ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Build Agent, to improve case resolution, order processing, and agent productivity. Develop test plans and test cases, conduct functional and regression testing, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with relevant stakeholders. Manage deployments across ServiceNow instances using update sets and application repositories while following established change management, release management, and source-control practices. Prepare release notes, technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training. Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and permanent issue resolution within agreed SLAs. Monitor platform health, data quality, and application performance while proactively identifying process gaps, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement. Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform optimization. Maintain solution documentation, data models, process flows, and technical specifications while contributing to product backlogs and Agile sprint planning. Collaborate with architects, developers, and platform owners to ensure compliance with security standards, access controls (ACLs), data governance, and regulatory requirements. Monitor solution adoption and business performance through dashboards and Performance Analytics, tracking KPIs such as case resolution time, order cycle time, and SLA attainment. Mentor junior analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of ServiceNow best practices across the organization. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with ServiceNow as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer. Demonstrated implementation and production support experience in at least two of the following ServiceNow modules: Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM). Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment and ongoing support. Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, platform upgrades, and release cycles. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification and ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification are required. ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) certifications are preferred. Certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or equivalent manufacturing-focused ServiceNow credentials are a strong advantage. Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model, tables, access control lists (ACLs), roles, CMDB, and customer service data structures. Proficiency in JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development. Practical experience integrating ServiceNow with Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JDBC, Integration Hub, MID Server, import sets, and transform maps. Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM, case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK). Working knowledge of agentic AI capabilities, including configuring and governing AI Agents, developing agentic workflows, selecting model providers, and managing Now Assist administration, licensing, and governance guardrails. Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces, particularly Customer Service Workspace. Understanding of business processes such as order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement management, warranty management, and contract management. Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, user story development, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps. Ability to prepare functional specifications, test cases, process documentation, and technical presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions rather than temporary workarounds. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to balance competing priorities across commercial, customer service, manufacturing, and IT teams. Customer-focused mindset, with an emphasis on measurable business outcomes, solution adoption, and service quality. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced Agile environment. Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore development teams. Additional advantages: Hands-on experience with MCO and manufacturing commercial processes, including contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility. Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions such as ServiceNow SOM, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order workflows, and ERP integrations. Additional certifications in ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence. Experience developing custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create intelligent workflows. Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and PLM or MES solutions. Familiarity with CI/CD processes, Git integration, source control, and Automated Test Framework (ATF). Exposure to data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Previous experience coordinating projects or mentoring junior team members. Working Conditions: Primarily remote working arrangement, with occasional business travel. Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production incidents. Availability for occasional after-hours support during releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities. Candidates must be based locally within the position's designated location. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available. Benefits: Primarily remote working environment, offering flexibility in day-to-day work. Opportunity to work with advanced ServiceNow enterprise solutions and AI-powered technologies. Exposure to large-scale digital transformation projects across customer service, manufacturing, and commercial operations. Opportunity to develop expertise in ServiceNow CSM, MCO, SOM, integrations, and agentic AI. Professional development through continuous learning, platform upgrades, and exposure to emerging technologies. Collaborative working environment involving international stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams. Opportunities to contribute to strategic IT initiatives and continuous improvement projects. needs_verification.title: Video Analyst & Quality Check Executive
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Video Analysis and Monitoring: Review CCTV and self-checkout (SCO) surveillance footage to identify suspicious activities, missed scans, product switching, incomplete payments, and other transaction irregularities. Compare video recordings with transaction details to verify potential retail losses and accurately assess customer interactions at checkout counters. Classify reviewed transactions according to established guidelines while meeting daily productivity and review targets. Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks on transactions reviewed by other analysts, verify classifications, and identify missed incidents, reporting discrepancies, and errors. Provide constructive feedback to analysts, maintain quality assurance records, and contribute to improving overall review accuracy. AI Alert Verification: Examine alerts generated by AI-powered video analytics systems, validate potential incidents, and distinguish genuine irregularities from false positives. Identify recurring AI detection errors and communicate relevant findings to the appropriate teams. Data Management and Reporting: Maintain accurate daily productivity and quality reports, record transaction IDs and review outcomes, and update Excel spreadsheets, tracking systems, and internal dashboards. Escalate unusual or critical incidents to supervisors while maintaining strict confidentiality of surveillance footage and transaction information. Team Coordination: Work closely with team leaders and quality assurance colleagues, follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), participate in training sessions, and support continuous process improvement. Requirements Minimum educational qualification of Higher Secondary (12th pass); a graduate degree in any discipline is preferred. Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply. Strong observation skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify subtle discrepancies in video footage and transaction records. Basic computer proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Good analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, particularly when reviewing transactions and identifying potential irregularities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and reporting incidents. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and supervisors. Good time management and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy while meeting daily productivity targets. Discipline, responsibility, consistency, and willingness to work with repetitive video-review tasks. Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies, tools, and review methodologies. Previous experience in CCTV monitoring, video surveillance, retail operations, transaction verification, quality assurance, data entry, or transaction auditing is an advantage but not mandatory. Familiarity with self-checkout systems and retail transaction processes is considered a plus. Benefits Opportunity to work with advanced AI-powered retail analytics and intelligent surveillance technologies. Hands-on exposure to artificial intelligence, computer vision, and automated transaction monitoring systems. Professional training in video analysis, transaction verification, and quality assurance processes. Opportunity to develop practical technical, analytical, and operational skills. Potential career progression into roles such as: Senior Video Analyst Quality Analyst Team Leader Operations Supervisor Full-time employment opportunity. Opportunity to contribute to improving retail security, loss prevention, and operational efficiency. needs_verification.title: Demand Planner
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: As Demand Planner, you will own forecast accuracy and the assumptions behind your assigned portfolio. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes. Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts. Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, including at least 1–2 years in demand planning or a closely related role. You should have experience managing a customer or category portfolio through a complete monthly forecasting cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the confidence to explain and defend planning assumptions. Success in this role requires both technical proficiency and the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial and operational teams. 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least 1–2 years as a Demand Planner, Demand Planning Analyst, or in an equivalent position. Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly demand forecasting cycle. Proficiency in Anaplan, with hands-on experience using demand planning or integrated business planning platforms. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system for managing order, shipment, and inventory history. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to manage and analyze large datasets. Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare clear presentations for consensus meetings and leadership discussions. Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals and the judgment to identify when commercial adjustments are necessary. Ability to document forecast assumptions, explain variances, and communicate analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to influencing stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization. Experience in a consumer packaged goods (CPG), beverage, or manufacturing environment. Strong ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving organization. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with NielsenIQ, Circana, SPINS, or other syndicated and POS data sources. Familiarity with retailer platforms such as Retail Link or Vendor Central. Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau. Previous involvement in an Anaplan or comparable planning platform implementation, including user acceptance testing, data validation, or migration from spreadsheet-based planning. Anaplan Level 1 certification or equivalent platform training. Exposure to annual operating plan or budgeting cycles in partnership with Finance. Benefits : Annual compensation of $80,000–$90,000, plus bonus. Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to take ownership of a customer and product portfolio and influence business planning decisions. Exposure to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, and Supply Planning. Opportunity to contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of Anaplan-based planning processes. Collaborative, feedback-oriented culture that values initiative, curiosity, transparency, and professional growth. Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven business focused on making consumer health more accessible. needs_verification.title: Hindi Quality Coordinator – LLM Data & Model Training
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Coordinate Hindi language quality activities: Support the planning and execution of linguistic quality processes for AI training, data generation, and model evaluation projects. Ensure linguistic accuracy: Review Hindi-language content and datasets to assess grammar, spelling, vocabulary, fluency, cultural relevance, and overall linguistic consistency. Support LLM data preparation: Contribute to the validation, annotation, and refinement of Hindi-language datasets used for training and evaluating large language models. Monitor data quality: Identify linguistic inconsistencies, errors, ambiguities, and potential quality issues, ensuring that data meets established project guidelines and quality benchmarks. Coordinate quality workflows: Work with linguists, reviewers, data specialists, and project teams to organize quality assurance activities and maintain consistent delivery standards. Evaluate AI-generated content: Assess Hindi-language model outputs for accuracy, relevance, naturalness, contextual understanding, and alignment with linguistic and cultural expectations. Provide feedback and recommendations: Document recurring issues, communicate quality findings, and recommend improvements to annotation guidelines, review processes, and linguistic standards. Maintain project documentation: Ensure quality reports, review results, feedback records, and project-related documentation are accurate and up to date. Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance linguistic evaluation methods, data quality processes, and overall model training effectiveness. Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address quality concerns, resolve project challenges, and ensure alignment with delivery expectations. Requirements: Excellent written and spoken Hindi proficiency, with a strong understanding of grammar, syntax, vocabulary, semantics, and regional language variations. Strong English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international teams and understand project documentation and instructions. Experience in linguistic quality assurance, translation, proofreading, localization, language annotation, content review, or multilingual data projects. Understanding of AI, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, with an interest in contributing to AI development. Familiarity with data annotation, linguistic evaluation, content validation, or quality assessment workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic inaccuracies, inconsistencies, contextual errors, and subtle differences in meaning. Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating language quality and AI-generated responses. Strong organizational and coordination abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks, follow detailed guidelines, and meet project deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and document quality findings. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams. Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and evolving AI data quality methodologies. Additional advantages: Previous experience working on LLM training, AI evaluation, or generative AI data projects. Familiarity with annotation platforms, linguistic quality tools, and data management systems. Experience coordinating language teams, reviewers, or quality assurance workflows. Knowledge of Hindi dialects, regional expressions, cultural nuances, and contextual language usage. Academic background in Hindi, linguistics, translation studies, computational linguistics, or a related discipline. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, based in India. Opportunity to contribute to innovative multilingual AI and LLM development projects. Exposure to artificial intelligence, natural language processing, machine learning, and advanced language technologies. Opportunity to apply and develop Hindi linguistic expertise in a growing technology-driven industry. Collaboration with international teams and multilingual language professionals. Exposure to large-scale projects supporting global clients across diverse industries. Opportunities to develop expertise in AI data quality, linguistic evaluation, and model training. Dynamic and collaborative working environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. strong_shortlist.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. review_queue.title: Operations Analyst
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: You will manage the operational processes supporting market data distribution, ensuring accurate licensing administration, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with external providers and internal stakeholders. Manage new data licensing agreements and renewals with exchange groups and other market data providers. Track licensing terms, renewal dates, contractual obligations, and deadlines to ensure continuous compliance. Prepare and submit accurate monthly usage reports for each data feed to the relevant data providers within established deadlines. Monitor licensing arrangements for brokers and partners redistributing market data, maintaining up-to-date evidence of their distribution licenses and authorizations. Enable and disable data feeds for broker and partner customers in accordance with their licensing agreements and contractual requirements. Respond to data provider audits and inquiries, ensuring that licensing records and supporting documentation remain complete and accurate. Identify opportunities to improve and automate licensing, reporting, and entitlement management processes. Assist with customer support inquiries related to market data feeds, licensing, and access permissions. Collaborate with internal teams across market data, sales, legal, finance, and engineering to ensure smooth operational coordination. Requirements The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple operational responsibilities and recurring deadlines in a financial services environment. At least 2 years of experience in operations, ideally in market data administration, data licensing, or vendor management within financial services. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Strong organizational and time-management abilities, particularly when managing multiple counterparties, contractual obligations, and recurring deadlines. Ability to read, interpret, and apply contractual terms and data licensing requirements. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Familiarity with exchange market data policies and usage reporting requirements, including NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe, OPRA, and CTA/UTP, is an advantage. Experience with market data inventory and usage reporting tools is a plus. SQL or scripting knowledge for reporting automation is beneficial. Understanding of financial markets and related industry practices is an advantage. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and adapt to a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working remotely within a globally distributed team. Benefits Competitive salary. Stock options. Health benefits. One-time USD 500 allowance for setting up your home office when joining. Monthly USD 150 stipend provided through a Brex Card. Opportunity to work with an international and geographically distributed team. Exposure to innovative financial technology and global market data infrastructure. review_queue.title: Endpoint Operations Analyst (L1) – Intune & SCCM
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Provide first-level support for Windows endpoint incidents and service requests. Perform routine checks of device health, availability, connectivity, and configuration. Support device enrollment and provisioning activities by following approved procedures. Conduct initial checks on Intune and SCCM/MECM policy synchronization and device compliance issues. Assist with Windows Autopilot enrollment and endpoint lifecycle activities. Monitor operating system patching status and report failed, pending, or unsuccessful updates. Perform approved software installation checks, deployment validation, and basic troubleshooting. Support routine Windows update checks and post-patching validation. Identify application installation failures and escalate unresolved issues to L2 support. Assist with approved driver, firmware, and configuration update activities. Perform basic checks on device compliance, encryption status, and configuration policies. Identify issues involving BitLocker, device configuration, and policy application, collecting relevant diagnostic information for escalation. Coordinate security-related incidents with the dedicated Defender and Security teams through established procedures. Log, categorize, prioritize, and track incidents and service requests using ServiceNow or an equivalent ITSM platform. Follow approved runbooks and standard operating procedures when performing initial troubleshooting. Escalate unresolved issues within defined SLAs and established escalation procedures. Maintain accurate ticket updates, operational checklists, and shift handover documentation. Coordinate with L2/L3 specialists, Service Desk, Identity, Security, and Application teams. Follow ITIL Incident, Change, and Request Management processes. Support effective handovers across APAC, EMEA, and North America to maintain uninterrupted 24/7 operations. Requirements: At least 2 years of experience in IT support, Windows endpoint operations, desktop support, or device management. Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems and endpoint troubleshooting. Familiarity with Windows updates, software installation, device connectivity, and system settings. Basic understanding of Microsoft Intune and/or SCCM/MECM. Knowledge of device enrollment, configuration policies, and endpoint compliance fundamentals. Basic understanding of BitLocker, encryption, and Windows security configurations. Familiarity with ServiceNow or an equivalent IT service management (ITSM) platform. Understanding of incident management, SLA compliance, ticket prioritization, and escalation procedures. Good communication, documentation, and shift handover skills. Ability to follow technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, and established security policies. Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and reporting technical issues. Willingness to work rotational shifts in a 24/7 production support environment. Preferred Qualifications: Basic PowerShell scripting knowledge. Exposure to Windows Autopilot and endpoint provisioning. Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and device registration. Basic understanding of application deployment and patch management. Microsoft MD-102 fundamentals or equivalent endpoint management training. Exposure to enterprise monitoring and endpoint management tools. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within India. Opportunity to gain experience supporting enterprise-scale Windows endpoint environments. Practical exposure to Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows Autopilot, and endpoint compliance technologies. Experience working within global IT operations and 24/7 support environments. Collaboration with international technical teams and opportunities to develop IT support expertise. Exposure to structured ITIL processes, incident management, and enterprise service delivery. Opportunity for continuous learning and professional development in endpoint management. Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, shift allowances, and other specific compensation or benefits are not disclosed in the job description. review_queue.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
review_queue.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. review_queue.title: IT Solutions Analyst
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process mapping involving sales, customer service, manufacturing, and finance teams. Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical solution designs aligned with ServiceNow best practices. Evaluate the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, prioritizing out-of-the-box (OOTB) solutions over unnecessary customizations. Configure, enhance, and support ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), including case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, and knowledge management. Develop and maintain Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) capabilities, including product and quote catalogs, order capture, fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and manufacturing workflows. Design and develop custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Workspaces, and Service Portal. Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony platforms, on-premise applications, and databases using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets. Implement, configure, and optimize ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Build Agent, to improve case resolution, order processing, and agent productivity. Develop test plans and test cases, conduct functional and regression testing, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with relevant stakeholders. Manage deployments across ServiceNow instances using update sets and application repositories while following established change management, release management, and source-control practices. Prepare release notes, technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training. Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and permanent issue resolution within agreed SLAs. Monitor platform health, data quality, and application performance while proactively identifying process gaps, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement. Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform optimization. Maintain solution documentation, data models, process flows, and technical specifications while contributing to product backlogs and Agile sprint planning. Collaborate with architects, developers, and platform owners to ensure compliance with security standards, access controls (ACLs), data governance, and regulatory requirements. Monitor solution adoption and business performance through dashboards and Performance Analytics, tracking KPIs such as case resolution time, order cycle time, and SLA attainment. Mentor junior analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of ServiceNow best practices across the organization. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with ServiceNow as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer. Demonstrated implementation and production support experience in at least two of the following ServiceNow modules: Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM). Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment and ongoing support. review_queue.title: Video Analyst & Quality Check Executive
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Video Analysis and Monitoring: Review CCTV and self-checkout (SCO) surveillance footage to identify suspicious activities, missed scans, product switching, incomplete payments, and other transaction irregularities. Compare video recordings with transaction details to verify potential retail losses and accurately assess customer interactions at checkout counters. Classify reviewed transactions according to established guidelines while meeting daily productivity and review targets. Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks on transactions reviewed by other analysts, verify classifications, and identify missed incidents, reporting discrepancies, and errors. Provide constructive feedback to analysts, maintain quality assurance records, and contribute to improving overall review accuracy. AI Alert Verification: Examine alerts generated by AI-powered video analytics systems, validate potential incidents, and distinguish genuine irregularities from false positives. Identify recurring AI detection errors and communicate relevant findings to the appropriate teams. Data Management and Reporting: Maintain accurate daily productivity and quality reports, record transaction IDs and review outcomes, and update Excel spreadsheets, tracking systems, and internal dashboards. Escalate unusual or critical incidents to supervisors while maintaining strict confidentiality of surveillance footage and transaction information. Team Coordination: Work closely with team leaders and quality assurance colleagues, follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), participate in training sessions, and support continuous process improvement. Requirements Minimum educational qualification of Higher Secondary (12th pass); a graduate degree in any discipline is preferred. Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply. Strong observation skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify subtle discrepancies in video footage and transaction records. Basic computer proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Good analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, particularly when reviewing transactions and identifying potential irregularities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and reporting incidents. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and supervisors. Good time management and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy while meeting daily productivity targets. Discipline, responsibility, consistency, and willingness to work with repetitive video-review tasks. Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies, tools, and review methodologies. Previous experience in CCTV monitoring, video surveillance, retail operations, transaction verification, quality assurance, data entry, or transaction auditing is an advantage but not mandatory. Familiarity with self-checkout systems and retail transaction processes is considered a plus. Benefits Opportunity to work with advanced AI-powered retail analytics and intelligent surveillance technologies. Hands-on exposure to artificial intelligence, computer vision, and automated transaction monitoring systems. review_queue.title: Demand Planner
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: As Demand Planner, you will own forecast accuracy and the assumptions behind your assigned portfolio. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes. Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts. Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, including at least 1–2 years in demand planning or a closely related role. You should have experience managing a customer or category portfolio through a complete monthly forecasting cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the confidence to explain and defend planning assumptions. Success in this role requires both technical proficiency and the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial and operational teams. 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least 1–2 years as a Demand Planner, Demand Planning Analyst, or in an equivalent position. Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly demand forecasting cycle. Proficiency in Anaplan, with hands-on experience using demand planning or integrated business planning platforms. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system for managing order, shipment, and inventory history. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to manage and analyze large datasets. Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare clear presentations for consensus meetings and leadership discussions. Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals and the judgment to identify when commercial adjustments are necessary. Ability to document forecast assumptions, explain variances, and communicate analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to influencing stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization. Experience in a consumer packaged goods (CPG), beverage, or manufacturing environment. Strong ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving organization. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with NielsenIQ, Circana, SPINS, or other syndicated and POS data sources. Familiarity with retailer platforms such as Retail Link or Vendor Central. Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau. Previous involvement in an Anaplan or comparable planning platform implementation, including user acceptance testing, data validation, or migration from spreadsheet-based planning. Anaplan Level 1 certification or equivalent platform training. Exposure to annual operating plan or budgeting cycles in partnership with Finance. Benefits : Annual compensation of $80,000–$90,000, plus bonus. Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to take ownership of a customer and product portfolio and influence business planning decisions. Exposure to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, and Supply Planning. Opportunity to contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of Anaplan-based planning processes. Collaborative, feedback-oriented culture that values initiative, curiosity, transparency, and professional growth. Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven business focused on making consumer health more accessible. review_queue.title: Hindi Quality Coordinator – LLM Data & Model Training
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Coordinate Hindi language quality activities: Support the planning and execution of linguistic quality processes for AI training, data generation, and model evaluation projects. Ensure linguistic accuracy: Review Hindi-language content and datasets to assess grammar, spelling, vocabulary, fluency, cultural relevance, and overall linguistic consistency. Support LLM data preparation: Contribute to the validation, annotation, and refinement of Hindi-language datasets used for training and evaluating large language models. Monitor data quality: Identify linguistic inconsistencies, errors, ambiguities, and potential quality issues, ensuring that data meets established project guidelines and quality benchmarks. Coordinate quality workflows: Work with linguists, reviewers, data specialists, and project teams to organize quality assurance activities and maintain consistent delivery standards. Evaluate AI-generated content: Assess Hindi-language model outputs for accuracy, relevance, naturalness, contextual understanding, and alignment with linguistic and cultural expectations. Provide feedback and recommendations: Document recurring issues, communicate quality findings, and recommend improvements to annotation guidelines, review processes, and linguistic standards. Maintain project documentation: Ensure quality reports, review results, feedback records, and project-related documentation are accurate and up to date. Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance linguistic evaluation methods, data quality processes, and overall model training effectiveness. Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address quality concerns, resolve project challenges, and ensure alignment with delivery expectations. Requirements: Excellent written and spoken Hindi proficiency, with a strong understanding of grammar, syntax, vocabulary, semantics, and regional language variations. Strong English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international teams and understand project documentation and instructions. Experience in linguistic quality assurance, translation, proofreading, localization, language annotation, content review, or multilingual data projects. Understanding of AI, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, with an interest in contributing to AI development. Familiarity with data annotation, linguistic evaluation, content validation, or quality assessment workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic inaccuracies, inconsistencies, contextual errors, and subtle differences in meaning. Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating language quality and AI-generated responses. Strong organizational and coordination abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks, follow detailed guidelines, and meet project deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and document quality findings. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams. Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and evolving AI data quality methodologies. Additional advantages: Previous experience working on LLM training, AI evaluation, or generative AI data projects. Familiarity with annotation platforms, linguistic quality tools, and data management systems. Experience coordinating language teams, reviewers, or quality assurance workflows. Knowledge of Hindi dialects, regional expressions, cultural nuances, and contextual language usage. Academic background in Hindi, linguistics, translation studies, computational linguistics, or a related discipline. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, based in India. Opportunity to contribute to innovative multilingual AI and LLM development projects. Exposure to artificial intelligence, natural language processing, machine learning, and advanced language technologies. Opportunity to apply and develop Hindi linguistic expertise in a growing technology-driven industry. Collaboration with international teams and multilingual language professionals. Exposure to large-scale projects supporting global clients across diverse industries. Opportunities to develop expertise in AI data quality, linguistic evaluation, and model training. Dynamic and collaborative working environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. human_review.description: Accountabilities: You will manage the operational processes supporting market data distribution, ensuring accurate licensing administration, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with external providers and internal stakeholders. Manage new data licensing agreements and renewals with exchange groups and other market data providers. Track licensing terms, renewal dates, contractual obligations, and deadlines to ensure continuous compliance. Prepare and submit accurate monthly usage reports for each data feed to the relevant data providers within established deadlines. Monitor licensing arrangements for brokers and partners redistributing market data, maintaining up-to-date evidence of their distribution licenses and authorizations. Enable and disable data feeds for broker and partner customers in accordance with their licensing agreements and contractual requirements. Respond to data provider audits and inquiries, ensuring that licensing records and supporting documentation remain complete and accurate. Identify opportunities to improve and automate licensing, reporting, and entitlement management processes. Assist with customer support inquiries related to market data feeds, licensing, and access permissions. Collaborate with internal teams across market data, sales, legal, finance, and engineering to ensure smooth operational coordination. Requirements The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple operational responsibilities and recurring deadlines in a financial services environment. At least 2 years of experience in operations, ideally in market data administration, data licensing, or vendor management within financial services. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Strong organizational and time-management abilities, particularly when managing multiple counterparties, contractual obligations, and recurring deadlines. Ability to read, interpret, and apply contractual terms and data licensing requirements. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Familiarity with exchange market data policies and usage reporting requirements, including NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe, OPRA, and CTA/UTP, is an advantage. Experience with market data inventory and usage reporting tools is a plus. SQL or scripting knowledge for reporting automation is beneficial. Understanding of financial markets and related industry practices is an advantage. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and adapt to a fast-paced environment. Basic understanding of BitLocker, encryption, and Windows security configurations. Familiarity with ServiceNow or an equivalent IT service management (ITSM) platform. human_review.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
human_review.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. Good to Have Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools. Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
