Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to use data analysis techniques to investigate and validate information. Experience with SQL is preferred; exposure to Python is an advantage. Ability to conduct effective internet research using websites, web portals, and databases. Familiarity with the US healthcare industry, particularly master data management for healthcare organizations, is preferred. Willingness to develop knowledge of master data management practices and the pharmaceutical supply chain. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage assignments and follow through consistently. Flexibility and adaptability when responding to feedback, changing priorities, and evolving processes. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team. Availability to work Monday through Friday on a schedule aligned with US Eastern Time. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement from India. verification_backlog.title: IT Solutions Analyst
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process mapping involving sales, customer service, manufacturing, and finance teams. Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical solution designs aligned with ServiceNow best practices. Evaluate the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, prioritizing out-of-the-box (OOTB) solutions over unnecessary customizations. Configure, enhance, and support ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), including case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, and knowledge management. Develop and maintain Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) capabilities, including product and quote catalogs, order capture, fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and manufacturing workflows. Design and develop custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Workspaces, and Service Portal. Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony platforms, on-premise applications, and databases using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets. Implement, configure, and optimize ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Build Agent, to improve case resolution, order processing, and agent productivity. Develop test plans and test cases, conduct functional and regression testing, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with relevant stakeholders. Manage deployments across ServiceNow instances using update sets and application repositories while following established change management, release management, and source-control practices. Prepare release notes, technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training. Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and permanent issue resolution within agreed SLAs. Monitor platform health, data quality, and application performance while proactively identifying process gaps, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement. Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform optimization. Maintain solution documentation, data models, process flows, and technical specifications while contributing to product backlogs and Agile sprint planning. Collaborate with architects, developers, and platform owners to ensure compliance with security standards, access controls (ACLs), data governance, and regulatory requirements. Monitor solution adoption and business performance through dashboards and Performance Analytics, tracking KPIs such as case resolution time, order cycle time, and SLA attainment. Mentor junior analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of ServiceNow best practices across the organization. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with ServiceNow as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer. Demonstrated implementation and production support experience in at least two of the following ServiceNow modules: Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM). Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment and ongoing support. Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, platform upgrades, and release cycles. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification and ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification are required. ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) certifications are preferred. Certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or equivalent manufacturing-focused ServiceNow credentials are a strong advantage. Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model, tables, access control lists (ACLs), roles, CMDB, and customer service data structures. Proficiency in JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development. Practical experience integrating ServiceNow with Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JDBC, Integration Hub, MID Server, import sets, and transform maps. Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM, case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK). Working knowledge of agentic AI capabilities, including configuring and governing AI Agents, developing agentic workflows, selecting model providers, and managing Now Assist administration, licensing, and governance guardrails. Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces, particularly Customer Service Workspace. Understanding of business processes such as order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement management, warranty management, and contract management. verification_backlog.title: Demand Planner
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: As Demand Planner, you will own forecast accuracy and the assumptions behind your assigned portfolio. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes. Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts. Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, including at least 1–2 years in demand planning or a closely related role. You should have experience managing a customer or category portfolio through a complete monthly forecasting cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the confidence to explain and defend planning assumptions. Success in this role requires both technical proficiency and the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial and operational teams. 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least 1–2 years as a Demand Planner, Demand Planning Analyst, or in an equivalent position. Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly demand forecasting cycle. Proficiency in Anaplan, with hands-on experience using demand planning or integrated business planning platforms. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system for managing order, shipment, and inventory history. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to manage and analyze large datasets. Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare clear presentations for consensus meetings and leadership discussions. Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals and the judgment to identify when commercial adjustments are necessary. Ability to document forecast assumptions, explain variances, and communicate analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to influencing stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization. Experience in a consumer packaged goods (CPG), beverage, or manufacturing environment. Strong ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving organization. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with NielsenIQ, Circana, SPINS, or other syndicated and POS data sources. Familiarity with retailer platforms such as Retail Link or Vendor Central. Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau. Previous involvement in an Anaplan or comparable planning platform implementation, including user acceptance testing, data validation, or migration from spreadsheet-based planning. Anaplan Level 1 certification or equivalent platform training. Exposure to annual operating plan or budgeting cycles in partnership with Finance. Benefits : Annual compensation of $80,000–$90,000, plus bonus. Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to take ownership of a customer and product portfolio and influence business planning decisions. Exposure to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, and Supply Planning. Opportunity to contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of Anaplan-based planning processes. Collaborative, feedback-oriented culture that values initiative, curiosity, transparency, and professional growth. Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven business focused on making consumer health more accessible. Commitment to providing reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment. Equal opportunity employer committed to considering qualified applicants fairly and without discrimination. verification_backlog.title: Hindi Quality Coordinator – LLM Data & Model Training
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Coordinate Hindi language quality activities: Support the planning and execution of linguistic quality processes for AI training, data generation, and model evaluation projects. Ensure linguistic accuracy: Review Hindi-language content and datasets to assess grammar, spelling, vocabulary, fluency, cultural relevance, and overall linguistic consistency. Support LLM data preparation: Contribute to the validation, annotation, and refinement of Hindi-language datasets used for training and evaluating large language models. Monitor data quality: Identify linguistic inconsistencies, errors, ambiguities, and potential quality issues, ensuring that data meets established project guidelines and quality benchmarks. Coordinate quality workflows: Work with linguists, reviewers, data specialists, and project teams to organize quality assurance activities and maintain consistent delivery standards. Evaluate AI-generated content: Assess Hindi-language model outputs for accuracy, relevance, naturalness, contextual understanding, and alignment with linguistic and cultural expectations. Provide feedback and recommendations: Document recurring issues, communicate quality findings, and recommend improvements to annotation guidelines, review processes, and linguistic standards. Maintain project documentation: Ensure quality reports, review results, feedback records, and project-related documentation are accurate and up to date. Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance linguistic evaluation methods, data quality processes, and overall model training effectiveness. Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address quality concerns, resolve project challenges, and ensure alignment with delivery expectations. Requirements: Excellent written and spoken Hindi proficiency, with a strong understanding of grammar, syntax, vocabulary, semantics, and regional language variations. Strong English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international teams and understand project documentation and instructions. Experience in linguistic quality assurance, translation, proofreading, localization, language annotation, content review, or multilingual data projects. Understanding of AI, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, with an interest in contributing to AI development. Familiarity with data annotation, linguistic evaluation, content validation, or quality assessment workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic inaccuracies, inconsistencies, contextual errors, and subtle differences in meaning. Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating language quality and AI-generated responses. Strong organizational and coordination abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks, follow detailed guidelines, and meet project deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and document quality findings. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams. Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and evolving AI data quality methodologies. Additional advantages: Previous experience working on LLM training, AI evaluation, or generative AI data projects. Familiarity with annotation platforms, linguistic quality tools, and data management systems. Experience coordinating language teams, reviewers, or quality assurance workflows. Knowledge of Hindi dialects, regional expressions, cultural nuances, and contextual language usage. Academic background in Hindi, linguistics, translation studies, computational linguistics, or a related discipline. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, based in India. Opportunity to contribute to innovative multilingual AI and LLM development projects. Exposure to artificial intelligence, natural language processing, machine learning, and advanced language technologies. Opportunity to apply and develop Hindi linguistic expertise in a growing technology-driven industry. Collaboration with international teams and multilingual language professionals. Exposure to large-scale projects supporting global clients across diverse industries. Opportunities to develop expertise in AI data quality, linguistic evaluation, and model training. Dynamic and collaborative working environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
